A dual-world setting blending a mid-20th-century biology laboratory—featuring vintage brass microscopes, glass petri dishes, dark wooden desks under warm tungsten lamps, and glass plates—with an intricate subterranean macro cross-section of a subterranean ant empire. Rich dark ochre earth, damp soil textures, and curving dirt chambers are illuminated by dramatic chiaroscuro lighting, accented by glowing golden and cyan volumetric pheromone trails weaving through both the laboratory glass and the underground tunnels.
